core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Hormone Replacement Therapy; Men's Health; Respiratory Care; Oncology & Thyroid Care; General Therapeutics
specialty_focus: Alpha-Pharma Healthcare is an international pharmaceutical manufacturer specializing in affordable, high-quality generic prescription drugs, hormone therapies, and endocrine medications. It focuses on lowering global healthcare costs by providing cost-efficient equivalents to branded therapeutics, with a niche in endocrine and hormonal management. It supplies hospitals, institutions, and pharmacies across international territories, primarily in developing markets and the Middle East.
